evidence.title: 5G Testing Caused the Second COVID Wave? Viral Post Lacks ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as "False" the claim that the second wave of COVID-19 was caused due to testing of 5G, stating that 5G network did not cause the second wave of COVID-19 in India.

evidence.title: No, 5G 'radiation' has NOT caused the second wave of COVID-19 in ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as "False" the claim that 5G radiation is the cause behind the second wave of coronavirus pandemic in India, stating that 5G 'radiation' has NOT caused the second wave of COVID-19 in India.

evidence.title: Maps do not show link between coronavirus and 5G wireless
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated as "False" the claim that maps show a correlation between confirmed COVID-19 cases and where 5G wireless service has been installed, stating that maps do not show a link between coronavirus and 5G wireless.

outputs.notes_en: The fact checks from The Quint, Alt News, and AP News directly contradict the claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus or caused an increase in cases.
